about: Gantry5-gen1 (docs/specs/roofbed-robot.md, docs/specs/gantry5-prototype.md). Millimetres. x along the bed's length, y across, z up; z = 0 is the soil's surface. railAboveSoil is the top of the x rails; zStack is from there down to the tool's tip with the z axis up, so the tool's clearance over the soil is railAboveSoil - zStack (packages/core GANTRY5).

bench.about: A table-top gantry over a seed tray: proves homing, limits, the e-stop, the watering nozzle and the driver before anything goes on the roof.

full.about: Over the 3 m x 1.2 m bed, rails on posts standing on the bed's wooden frame.
